descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S29 「不是逐个点就离开列表的任务：Delete Pending Tasks & Complete 和口述关掉（事件暂缓在 Q5 / Q13）」 Tasks that leave the list without a per-task tap: 'Delete Pending Tasks & Complete' and closure by dictation (events held on Q5 / Q13)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 Completing a task and deleting a task are separate actions, and each is logged as its own analytics event (task completed / task deleted), one per tap, against the chart.（UAT TC-24；UAT OAT-06 item 7；TFA-94514 AC 2）
  • U9 No bulk delete anywhere in the app: records are deleted one at a time, and there is no 'delete all patients' or similar control.（UAT TC-24；TFA-92579 AC 2；TFA-94700 AC 5；TFA-94699 AC 6）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Fresh physician. Hospital chart 'QA Hosp Pending <tag>' with status note-ready and two pending tasks; the fixture Hospital patient with open tasks 'Recheck BMP in AM' and 'Order echo'; the Nursing Home resident with open tasks 'Repeat BMP Friday' and 'Weekly weight Monday'

When (a) Fixture Hospital patient, Encounter tab: type 'BMP came back, creatinine 1.1.' and press Save & Extract. (b) The resident: the same text, Save & Extract. (c) 'QA Hosp Pending': Post-Round → Mark Encounter Complete → in the Pending Tasks dialog press its delete-and-complete choice ('Delete Pending Tasks & Complete' …

Then Cells: way a task leaves the list × expected event. (a)/(b): the BMP task is closed and logged as one task-completed event against its chart, if Q13 says a dictation closure counts. (c): only that chart's two pending tasks are removed (the fixture patient's 'Order echo' stays, TFA-92595 AC 8) and each removed task is logged as a task-deleted event (two rows …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94514 AC 2 + UAT TC-24 bullet 4 / OAT-06 item 7 for the events; TFA-94700 AC 5 / TFA-92579 AC 2 against TFA-92595 AC 8 for the dialog (Q5). Checkpoints (oracle.mjs) judge only the visible outcome: the removed tasks are gone and the other chart's tasks stay. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S29 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-24.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
